task.title: Refresh stale V2 provider health without unrelated task demand

scope.owned_layer: Supervisor Authority V2 post-dispatch reconciliation of runtime delivery-health rows against the configured endpoint/account topology.
not_changing: TaskStore or canonical task lifecycle write ownership
runtime-state lock, reservation, CAS, or atomic-write primitives
provider credentials, provider configuration, or account rotation
retired V1 pause, recovery, or capacity control planes
product services, frontend, production, or capital authority

prior_round_gap.accepted_live_behavior: Bounded refresh produced fresh healthy codex1 and claude2 observations on distinct configured accounts.
prior_round_gap.remaining_failure: delivery_health.accounts.claude_account_shared_max_1 remained in runtime state even though no configured endpoint/account topology referenced it.
prior_round_gap.resolution: Reconcile delivery-health endpoint and account buckets against only the deliverable topology during the existing locked post-dispatch maintenance phase.

contract.topology_source: _configured_delivery_endpoints is the shared deliverable topology used by idle refresh and topology fingerprinting; provider declarations without endpoints are excluded.
contract.endpoint_ownership: delivery_health.endpoints may retain only configured deliverable endpoint ids.
contract.account_ownership: delivery_health.accounts may retain only account ids referenced by configured deliverable endpoints.
contract.preservation: Every configured endpoint/account entry, root delivery-health metadata, and all state outside delivery_health remain byte-equivalent.
contract.idempotence: When no orphan row exists, reconciliation returns false and does not replace delivery_health; a second pass over an unchanged topology is a pure no-op.
contract.observation_order: Post-dispatch maintenance applies live observations first and topology reconciliation second, so an obsolete in-flight or provider-only observation cannot persist an orphan row.
contract.write_authority: apply_post_dispatch_maintenance runs inside the existing post_dispatch_maintenance runtime reservation and whole-state CAS transaction; no new writer or lock primitive was added.
contract.refresh_compatibility: The prior due-only scan, authorized future-retry bypass, explicit Human/Ops trigger, refresh_max_per_cycle cap, and fail-closed observation projection are unchanged.

shared_claude_account_migration.proof: A former claude_shared endpoint and claude_account_shared_max_1 account are removed after topology moves to distinct claude1/claude2 endpoints and accounts.

configured_and_unrelated_state_preserved.proof: Configured claude1/claude2 entries, unrelated health metadata, workers, and watchdog state remain exactly equal.

idempotent_no_every_cycle_mutation.proof: The first pass removes only retired rows; the second pass returns false and leaves the complete state equal to the prior snapshot.

provider_only_orphan_cannot_remain.proof: A configured provider with no agent/delivery endpoint cannot retain either its endpoint projection or its orphan_account row after post-dispatch maintenance.

prior_refresh_contract_preserved.proof: All 20 account-health focused tests plus full supervisor, watchdog, provider-permissions, provider-health, dispatch-admission, and runtime-state suites passed.

review.exact_head_requirement: Antigravity must bind approval to the final GitHub PR head through governed REVIEW_PR and REVIEW_HEAD_SHA inputs. The manifest does not self-reference its containing commit; later source or evidence changes require fresh checksums and exact-head review.
required: Confirm only rows absent from _configured_delivery_endpoints and its referenced accounts are removed.
Confirm configured delivery-health entries and unrelated runtime state are preserved exactly.
Confirm reconciliation is invoked after observations inside post_dispatch_maintenance and therefore uses the existing runtime reservation/CAS authority.
Confirm the unchanged-topology second pass is a no-op and no per-cycle health mutation was introduced.
Confirm provider-only orphan rows cannot remain and no V1 or credential control plane was added.

post_merge_rollout.action: Promote the exact merged dev command runtime, run one governed bounded supervisor cycle, and read back the live runtime delivery_health document without manual state edits.
acceptance_readback: configured codex1 endpoint and account have fresh healthy live evidence
configured claude2 endpoint and distinct claude2 account have fresh healthy live evidence
no provider-only endpoint or account projection remains
post_merge_rollout.rollback: Promote the last accepted command runtime. V2 remains fail-closed on stale evidence; no credential or TaskStore rollback is required.
